en.title: IATA: Global air cargo demand up 7.7% in September, North America leads regions at 11.8%
en.summary: IATA reported September 2026 global air cargo demand, measured in cargo tonne-kilometers, rose 7.7% year on year, with international operations up 8.6% and capacity up 2.7%; North American carriers led regional growth at 11.8%, while high jet fuel prices continue to pressure profitability.
body: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) released data for September 2026 global air cargo markets: total demand, measured in cargo tonne-kilometers, increased by 7.7% compared with September 2025, with international operations up 8.6%; capacity, measured in available cargo tonne-kilometers, increased by 2.7%, with international operations up 3.3%. Growth extended across all regions, supported by stronger global trade and manufacturing, while AI-related shipments helped drive another month of double-digit growth across the Pacific.

North American carriers saw the strongest regional demand growth at 11.8% year on year, with capacity up just 0.8%; Asia-Pacific airlines grew 8.6% with capacity up 4.9%; European carriers grew 4.5% as capacity fell 1.6%; and Middle Eastern carriers posted the weakest growth at 3.8% with capacity up 7.0%. IATA said jet fuel prices have more than doubled compared with a year ago while yields have not kept pace, making profitable operations more challenging.

zh.title: IATA：9月全球航空貨運需求年增7.7％、北美成長11.8％居各區之冠
zh.summary: IATA公布2026年9月全球航空貨運數據，總需求以貨運噸公里計算較去年同期成長7.7％，運能成長2.7％；北美業者需求年增11.8％為各區最強，亞太成長8.6％，但燃油成本高漲仍壓縮業者獲利空間。
body: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）公布2026年9月全球航空貨運市場數據：以貨運噸公里計算的總需求較去年9月成長7.7％，其中國際業務成長8.6％；以可用貨運噸公里計算的運能年增2.7％，國際業務成長3.3％。成長遍及所有地區，全球貿易與製造業轉強提供支撐，人工智慧相關貨物也推動跨太平洋市場再度出現雙位數成長。
分區來看，北美業者需求年增11.8％，為各區最強，運能僅成長0.8％；亞太業者需求成長8.6％，運能成長4.9％；歐洲業者需求成長4.5％，運能減少1.6％；中東業者需求成長3.8％，為各區最弱。IATA指出，燃油價格較一年前翻倍以上、收益率未能跟上，獲利能力面臨挑戰。
